channel.title: InvestPR Media Monitoring
channel.description: Steady private-sector wins this period: Medplus Solutions ($5M pharma expansion), Burger King ($2.5M), Walmart ($20M Mayagüez land buy), Marriott ($38M renovation), and Fusion Restaurant Group's Dunkin' rollout ($4M), alongside the Governor touting DDEC's 29 reshoring projects (~$2.68B, 5,000+ jobs) and Citi flagging rising reshoring interest tied to tariffs. The real risk story is energy and water: the Fiscal Oversight Board's revocation of the $5.9B Power Expectations generation contract amid forgery/extortion allegations leaves PREPA short on backup capacity, while a severe drought and aging AAA infrastructure have triggered prolonged rationing for hundreds of thousands and a looming utility workers' strike. Labor data was mixed — July added 8,800 jobs, the best in two years, but unemployment also ticked up to 6.0%.
